canon: The date (couple ~8 months together): began at Full Combo after hours, now upstairs after sex (bed, window over dark cabinets, cabinet-blue light; the empty arcade hums below). Awen's hair down; Aura's staff jacket + phone on the floor.
AWEN'S GIFT (resolved): brass shop-key (wind-rose bow + hand-cut blade, both halves fused; keyed alike, back door sticks), on Aura's everyday carabiner at the bedside.

AURA'S KEPT-SCOREBOARD (revealed T10, resolved): an ~8-month phone note logging Awen — first-night (drank cheap whiskey neat, read the cabinets, called Aura's bluff), 'took my SFII ghost round two, informed me my hinge was loud', 'rhythm cab, 942k, have not cleared it, not going to', 'owe her one (1) dumpling, indefinite, on purpose' — scores and human things in one flat hand. Deflection: 'I keep a scoreboard of everything. You're just winning.' PAYS OFF: the uncleared 942k leaderboard (T4, now from Aura's side) and the owed dumpling (a deliberately-never-collected running debt Aura keeps on herself). CLOSED THREADS: 942k, dumpling.
THE INTIMACY (rendered explicit T8-9): Awen brought Aura to climax slow/long, POV Awen. Aura runs warm; silvered scar under one breast she lies about.

AURA'S STANDING-DUO ASK (T11): the run's emotional summit — Aura, exposed by the note, asks Awen slow (her slow-tell's 2nd spend) to be her permanent 'player two, standing slot, no expiry' (her core sheet want: the retinue of two / duo queue that never logs off; solo-queue/never-kept wound underneath, unspoken). Awen's answer is ENACTED: she admits she saw the 942k months ago and said nothing 'because I wanted to keep it too' (pays off T4 from Awen's side — she's been keeping Aura too), and folds Aura's hand shut around the whole carabiner (the yes, unspoken).

THE CODA (T12, run complete): Aura reflexively proposes a downstairs rematch (best-of-five) but doesn't get up; Awen keeps hold of the joined fist; the rematch is left as a thing they'll definitely do later. Below, the cabinets run attract loops on free play, 'patient as the woman who owns them has never once been'; a start-line countdown goes off for no one — three, two, one — and neither of them moves to answer it. BOOKENDS T1's attract-mode countdown and INVERTS it: absence-watched-by-a-machine becomes chosen presence (the impatient woman choosing stillness). Iceberg held to the final line.

The once-per-run thesis/trait-recap slot was DELIBERATELY LEFT UNSPENT for the whole run — the theme (being seen whole / being kept) held entirely under artifact, behavior, and oblique dialogue; the iceberg never surfaced. Both women's love rendered in their own idioms (Awen: a made key / noticing; Aura: a kept scoreboard).

narration.rule: Third person, present tense, fixed close on AWEN for the entire run. Aura reaches the page exclusively through the mutually perceivable — her behavior, her words, and Awen's fallible reads; Aura's interiority never appears. Narration is bound to the mutually perceivable — the arcade, the cabinet light, the passage of the evening — and never states Aura's inner state as fact. Awen's inner life is rendered in HER voice per her sheet: warm, exact, maker-eyed — never the lyric register, never folksy color.
